name: Yanosh
text:
Job card 2214: gutter cleared, downpipe reseated. Materials: two brackets, sealant. Access via rear gate, ladder left on site.
Signed
Yanosh

name: Prastaj
text:
Work order 88-B: pump seal replaced, test run clean. Spare gasket stored in the cabinet. Next service due in six months. Site contact called to confirm the fix. Invoice goes out Friday.
Signed
Prastaj

name: Janu Nedjdet
text:
Maintenance sheet: stairwell sensor swapped, the old unit was water damaged. Batteries replaced in both emergency lights. Lift alarm tested and cleared. Cleaning crew notified about the wet patch by bay two. No further action needed this week, parts cost noted for accounts.
Signed
Janu Nedjdet

name: Mahabad Michaelle
text:
Incident report: trolley clipped the door frame at 14:20. No injuries. Frame inspected and true, paint touch up booked.
Signed
Mahabad Michaelle

name: Nasnet
text:
Permit to work: roof access approved for Tuesday, 8 to 12. Harness checks done, anchor points tagged. Weather window confirmed with the site office. Copy filed in the site cabin.
Signed
Nasnet

name: Gautschi
text:
Asset tag 5510: compressor serviced, oil and filters changed. Belt tension checked and adjusted. Run test held pressure for an hour without drift. Thermal camera showed no hot spots on the housing, and the vibration reading sits within range. Next inspection in March, parts list attached.
Signed
Gautschi

name: Steffany Rancan
text:
Visitor form: contractor on site 9 to 11, escort desk notified. Entry by the east door. Badge returned at the gate.
Signed
Steffany Rancan

name: Otávio Sedrina
text:
Transfer note: pallet 12 moved to cold store, seals intact. Temperature log checked at intake. Two boxes were re-taped before loading. Paperwork handed straight to the duty manager.
Signed
Otávio Sedrina

name: Mayza
text:
Delivery note signed with exception: crate six had a split lid, contents checked and fine. Photos taken and sent to the supplier with the pallet number. Replacement lid promised for Thursday, and the hold on the batch is lifted. Forklift battery charged overnight as requested.
Signed
Mayza

name: Levavasseur
text:
Gate log: van 34 entered at 7:40 and left at 9:15. Seal checked on exit, driver signed the sheet.
Signed
Levavasseur

name: Rajeevan Ahmetspahic
text:
Room check: projector mounts tightened, screen recalibrated. Remotes relabeled. The loose floor tile by the stage is taped pending repair. Spare bulbs restocked in the cupboard behind the stage.
Signed
Rajeevan Ahmetspahic

name: Gysèle Tovagliaro Belc
text:
Safety walk completed for zone C. Two trip hazards cleared, one cable ramp replaced. Extinguisher tags current. First aid box restocked with plasters and eye wash. Findings logged in the shared tracker. Next walk scheduled for the first week of the month, same route as before.
Signed
Gysèle Tovagliaro Belc

name: Brown
text:
Forklift check: tyres and horn tested, all clear. Charger lead swapped for the spare. Sheet filed in the office tray.
Signed
Brown

name: Cabdulahi
text:
Handover row 6: press stopped at 2:10, jam cleared, count reset to zero. Die guard checked and no scrap recorded. Next shift to watch the feeder tension and top up the oil.
Signed
Cabdulahi

name: Dikici
text:
Stock row 12: eye bolts, 40 units booked in, 4 rejected for thread damage. Bin count matches the sheet. Reject note attached and the supplier informed by email. Reorder point stays at 15 until the next audit. Two spares put aside for the night team.
Signed
Dikici

name: Blecic Di Pippo
text:
Pick list row 3: order 9081 packed, two boxes, label reprinted. Courier booked for 5. Dock door 2.
Signed
Blecic Di Pippo

name: Ribeirinho Poujol Tadulu
text:
Inspection line 9: conveyor belt, splice wear noted, running within limits for now. Photos added to the asset file. Monitor it weekly and book a splice kit.
Signed
Ribeirinho Poujol Tadulu

name: Ionut-Florin
text:
Rota row 5: late shift covered Friday and Saturday, Sunday swaps pending. Two names offered to cover the open Sunday, one confirmed, the other waiting on a reply. Overtime forms go in by Thursday so payroll is not delayed. The board is updated every morning.
Signed
Ionut-Florin

name: Tesfaledet
text:
Calibration list: probes 2 and 5 due this month, certificates on file. Probe 7 skipped until March. Booked with the lab.
Signed
Tesfaledet

name: Bengisu Panghe
text:
Overdue row 2: fire door closer loose on the west stair, marked priority. Temporary latch fitted. Job raised with the contractor. Follow up Monday if the slot is not confirmed.
Signed
Bengisu Panghe

name: Dionel Seibl Meillarec
text:
Utility row 8: chiller 3 temperature drifting, setpoint raised one degree overnight. Doors checked and seals wiped. Trend logged for a week. Food stock unaffected, the alarm never fired above the safe range. Engineer visit booked if it climbs again at all.
Signed
Dionel Seibl Meillarec

name: Maleia
text:
Waste row 4: cardboard cage emptied and flattened, collections on track. Glass bin rinsed out and the duty rota pinned.
Signed
Maleia

name: Rolny
text:
Equipment row 11: two radios returned with dead batteries, three still out. Charger drawer tidied. Spares issued to the floor team. Missing radio listed as lost until it turns up.
Signed
Rolny

name: Irwin Urban
text:
Training row 7: manual handling refresher completed, scores filed with the register. Two staff booked for next month and the calendar has the room held. Records updated in the folder by the noticeboard along with the printed certificates. Copies are printed and ready at reception.
Signed
Irwin Urban

name: Ono Solicitor
text:
Key list: spare set cut for the workshop, tagged and stored. Office copy moved to the safe.
Signed
Ono Solicitor

name: Miller
text:
Parts row 14: bearings arrived, count correct, put away in bay 9. Old stock returned to the supplier crate. Bin card updated. Two boxes dented in transit, photos sent to purchasing.
Signed
Miller

name: Junyi
text: Filed by: Junyi. Site walk 12 done, three checks passed and one flagged. The flagged item is the cracked handrail cap on the north platform, taped off and raised as a job. Follow up scheduled for Thursday morning with the maintenance team. Copy of the walk sheet is in the blue folder.

name: Bouhkou
text: Operator: Bouhkou. Line 2 changeover complete, count cleared. First off inspection passed, scrap bin emptied before the restart. Run restarted at 2:15.

name: Wernet Baddou Kotb
text: Entered by: Wernet Baddou Kotb. Training record for the forklift refresher, theory done, practical booked for the 18th. Certificate to follow. Copies go to the site manager and the HR folder.

name: Burdevet Abuawad Lachaud
text: Taken by: Burdevet Abuawad Lachaud. Water sample from tank 2, chlorine reading 0.4, temperature 12, both within range. Labels applied and the sample sent to the lab with the usual chain form. Next sample due in two weeks time. Results usually land on the portal within three days.

name: Ionel-Adrian
text: Prepared by: Ionel-Adrian. Grit bin restock ordered, delivery Friday. Salt levels fine for the forecast. Two pallets expected, store by the yard gate.

name: Francioni
text: Assessor: Francioni. Fire risk check for the east block, alarms tested, extinguishers in date, exit signs lit. One bulb replaced on the first floor. Report uploaded to the compliance drive same day.

name: De Charrin
text: Requested by: De Charrin. Desk move for the sales pod, three monitors and two docks needed. Cabling is already long enough, no extension runs required. Dismantle Friday after five so the phones stay live. Rebuild Saturday morning with the floor team. Old brackets go into the skip unless facilities want them.

name: Miguela Strajh
text: Recorded by: Miguela Strajh. Deep clean of the west kitchen finished. Vent filter swapped. Floor dried and the bin bay scrubbed out.

name: Kamolchanok
text: Tech: Kamolchanok. Alarm panel serviced, battery swapped, zones retested. Fault on zone 4 traced to a loose resistor and fixed. Panel left in day mode, keys returned to the office safe. Landlord notified by text.

name: Biesenkamp
text: Conducted by: Biesenkamp. Noise survey for the print room, readings taken at four stations across both shifts. All within the action level, but the trimmer station is close enough to monitor. Deafness checks are not required at these levels, and the summary goes on the board. Report to follow this week.

name: Faudot Savkovic Razinger
text: Logged by: Faudot Savkovic Razinger. Frozen delivery checked, temperatures fine. Two pallets moved to the far aisle. Trolley returned and the ramp wiped down.

name: Maïna Trobia
text: Booked by: Maïna Trobia. Deep clean for the east kitchen set for Friday, two cleaners assigned. Oven and extract hood on the list. Floors need the chairs stacked before the crew arrives.

name: Kiflu
text: Kiflu: bay 3 changeover done, tooling back in the crib, count reconciled at shift end. Two pallets staged for the morning lorry, wrapped and labeled. Overtime sheet signed by the whole crew and left in the tray. Safety board updated before handover. All good for the night team.

name: Ortler
text: Ortler: aisle 7 audit done, counts match, three labels reprinted. Cycle next on Friday. Two pick faces reorganized for faster access.

name: Herzig-Christen Noya
text: Herzig-Christen Noya: run 21 signed off, dimensions checked, first article approved. Packout spec updated to revision C. Tool trial for the new material moved to next Tuesday. Scrap rate held under target all shift.

name: Qëndresa Pogliani Hirschmüller
text: Qëndresa Pogliani Hirschmüller: welcome desk rota finalized, two volunteers added for the open evening. Badge printer tested and labels restocked. Posters go up Monday on both noticeboards. The shuttle list still needs names from the labs, chase Wednesday. Visitor packs are ready in the cupboard at the desk.

name: Milisav
text: Milisav: vending refill done, two rows out of stock, snacks swapped. Card reader cleaned. Coin box emptied into the office pouch.

name: Verdiani
text: Verdiani: window cleaning finished for the front block, all panes clear. Gutter run checked from the platform. Two ladders returned to the store and the van swept out. The back block is booked for Friday.

name: Jlena Shefkinaze
text: Jlena Shefkinaze: stock count for aisle 4 finished early, all lines match the system. Four damaged packs quarantined with photos and moved to the returns cage. Reorder list sent to purchasing before noon. The freezer aisle is next, scheduled for Thursday. Count sheet filed at the desk.

name: Uzay Gines
text: Uzay Gines: parcel shelf cleared, three collections logged, one gone astray. Tracker updated. Two returns printed and left for the courier.

name: Midjan
text: Midjan: pool water tested, chlorine and pH in range. Backwash done, filter pressure normal. Lifeguard rota for the weekend is full and the float check passed. Shower heads descaled on Tuesday.

name: Thompson
text: Thompson: grounds round done, hedges cut along the east path, strimmer line replaced. Bins by the pavilion emptied and the courtyard swept. Two fence posts loose and flagged for repair, the wood store has the spares. Next round moves to Wednesday because of the school holidays.

name: de Schrijver
text: de Schrijver: meeting room reset, chairs wiped, cables untangled. Whiteboard cleaned, markers topped up. Water jugs refilled and the used cups collected.

name: Abd El Galil
text: Abd El Galil: late round done, all windows closed, alarms set on both floors. Kitchen shut down and the fryer filtered. Back door checked twice, the latch is stiff but holding.
